svg.title: Blue and Green
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Two stacked biomorphic painted forms on paper. White/cream paper support retained; wavering brush edges simplified. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-blue-curve-09-2020/lightbox/works/47213; record matthewmarks-47213; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
